verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a few multi-item actions of its own: syncing transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities "in a single step", pulling full spend exports via its agent channels, and MCP prompts that act across sets of transactions (e.g. finding all transactions missing receipts). The CLI being "built for scripted loops" is only a building block for doing bulk work, not a bulk feature itself. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk endpoints or commands (e.g. bulk approve, bulk edit, bulk card issuance), bulk actions exposed via MCP/CLI, limits and semantics of batch operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
